name: Test

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - run: node --test

name: Update tables

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * 1' # Mondays 01:00 UTC = 09:00 Asia/Shanghai
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: update-tables
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Test the renderer
        run: node --test

      # Both values are secrets, so the logs mask them: a variable would
      # print the export URL in every public run log. Without them this step
      # prints a warning and writes nothing, so the run stays green until the
      # export is set up.
      - name: Render the tables from the BizPeel export
        id: update
        env:
          BIZPEEL_EXPORT_URL: ${{ secrets.BIZPEEL_EXPORT_URL }}
          BIZPEEL_EXPORT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BIZPEEL_EXPORT_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/update.mjs

      - name: Commit and push changed tables
        env:
          DATA_AS_OF: ${{ steps.update.outputs.data_as_of }}
          ROWS: ${{ steps.update.outputs.rows }}
        run: |
          git add -A -- '*.md'
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Tables unchanged; nothing to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m "data: update ${DATA_AS_OF} (${ROWS} startups)"
          git push
